note: Scheduled AI tasks of the forward test (New York time). Edited by hand when a task changes; scripts/spec.py prints it into ops/SPEC.md. The task prompts live in the scheduler; every prompt defers to ops/runbook.md.

tasks.name: Morning research + events
tasks.does: Picks its own stocks before the open and extra coins; logs scheduled market events

tasks.name: Stocks + control list
tasks.does: Reddit snapshot (ApeWisdom); scores the day's opening-range breakouts

tasks.name: Live decisions
tasks.does: Records breakouts, live option quotes and the ML choice before outcomes are known

tasks.name: Deep OTM + weekly options
tasks.does: Opens and settles the option structures; bars come from the data feed

tasks.name: Adaptive stocks
tasks.does: Scores the adaptive breakout settings and runs champion/challenger

tasks.name: Orchestrator
tasks.does: Checks the pipeline, regime, data checks; requests the nightly maths on GitHub; digest

tasks.name: Watchdog
tasks.does: Re-runs a failed task; logs problems only

tasks.name: Learning + strategy lab
tasks.does: Finds patterns in logged trades; invents and gate-tests one new strategy

tasks.name: AI judgment seal
tasks.does: Seals next week's weights from one evidence pack, with written reasons

tasks.name: Picks review
tasks.does: Agent picks against the watchlist and the control list

tasks.name: Independent audit
tasks.does: A session that did not build the system works through ops/audit_checklist.md

tasks.name: Interim report
tasks.does: Reading after 46 of 109 days; decides nothing

tasks.name: Final report
tasks.does: The verdict on the whole window

tasks.name: Lane review
tasks.when: Tuesdays in Feb, May, Aug, Nov at 10:41; acts only on the third Tuesday, first 2027-05-18
tasks.does: Promotes or retires challengers by the fixed rules of scripts/registry.py

github.name: 5-minute tick + engine
github.when: every 5 min 09:00-15:55 ET on weekdays (external pinger); backup at :50 each hour
github.does: Stores 5-minute bars; seals breakouts the moment they are detected; ML score at detection

github.name: Nightly fetch
github.does: Daily bars, dividends and splits, VIX, borrow file, option bars of open legs

github.name: Crypto ML fit
github.does: Second daily fit of the crypto ML family

github.name: Nightly maths (compute)
github.does: Library at 1x and 2x costs, ideal fills, allocator, statistics, checks, random-day replay, Monte Carlo, dashboard data, challenger-lane scores, this specification

github.name: Option bars (optbars)
github.does: 5-minute bars of every registered option leg

github.name: freeze-guard
github.does: Fails and opens an issue if a frozen script changed

github.name: no-orders
github.when: on pushes touching scripts or workflows
github.does: Fails and opens an issue if an order-related call appears

github.name: crypto tracks
github.when: every 3 h at :32 UTC, after the crypto bars
github.does: Runs the four crypto tracks, their ledger rows, ML shadow predictions and the daily review (scripts/daily.py crypto)

github.name: ML nightly
github.does: Rebuilds decision rows, scores shadow predictions, evaluates and refits the models (scripts/daily.py ml)
